items.title_cn: 国家发展改革委就《对外投资管理办法》答记者问
items.title_en: NDRC Briefs on New Outbound Investment Measures
items.title_original: 国家发展改革委有关负责同志就《对外投资管理办法》答记者问
items.source: 国家发展和改革委员会
items.what_happened: 2026年10月22日，国家发展改革委公布《对外投资管理办法》（2026年第49号令），自2026年12月1日起施行，2017年《企业境外投资管理办法》同步废止。投资者包括境内企业、其他组织和居民个人。
items.what_happened_en: On Oct 22, 2026, the NDRC published the Measures for the Administration of Outbound Investment (Order No. 49 of 2026), effective Dec 1, 2026, when the 2017 enterprise outbound investment measures are repealed. Investors now include domestic enterprises, other organizations and resident individuals.
items.why_it_matters: 对外投资流量从2017年1583亿美元增至2025年2136亿美元；扩大投资者范围并完善保护措施，影响企业和个人的境外投资。
items.why_it_matters_en: Outbound investment flows rose from $158.3B in 2017 to $213.6B in 2025; the broader investor definition and protection measures affect firms and individuals investing abroad.

items.title_cn: 英伟达将开放模型与机器人技术引入欧洲零售业
items.title_en: NVIDIA Brings Open Models and Robotics to European Retail
items.title_original: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations
items.what_happened: 欧洲零售商正在使用英伟达加速的开放模型与物理智能，包括一个将推理成本降低90%的商务平台，以及在数字孪生中模拟机器人车队的履约中心。Shopify 对 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 进行了后训练，用于其 Sidekick 助手中的一个 GraphQL 子代理。
items.what_happened_en: European retailers are using NVIDIA-accelerated open models and physical intelligence, including a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% and a fulfillment center simulating robotic fleets in a digital twin. Shopify post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for a GraphQL subagent in its Sidekick assistant.
items.why_it_matters: 推理成本降低90%表明开放模型可降低AI商务工具的成本，而数字孪生模拟则指向更协同的仓储机器人。
items.why_it_matters_en: The 90% inference cost cut illustrates how open models can lower the cost of AI commerce tools, while digital-twin simulation points to more coordinated warehouse robotics.

items.title_cn: 欧洲银行基于开放模型构建专有智能
items.title_en: European Banks Build Proprietary Intelligence on Open Models
items.title_original: Leading European Financial Services Organizations Embrace Open Models to Build Proprietary Intelligence
items.what_happened: 在GTC柏林大会上，Revolut表示正以单一基础模型PRAGMA重建技术栈，运行于NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPU及cuDF、Dynamo-Triton之上，初期服务8000万客户，设计可扩展3倍；Starling Bank被称为首家在加速基础设施上训练的银行。
items.what_happened_en: At GTC Berlin, Revolut said it is rebuilding its technology stack on a single foundation model, PRAGMA, running on NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs with cuDF and Dynamo-Triton, serving an initial 80 million customers and engineered to scale 3x; Starling Bank was described as the first bank to train on accelerated infrastructure.
items.why_it_matters: 这些公司将其展示为基于开放权重模型、运行于自有基础设施的生产级智能。
items.why_it_matters_en: The companies present this as production-scale intelligence built on open weight models running on their own infrastructure.

items.title_cn: NVIDIA推出Minerva，为AI工厂提供可观测性
items.title_en: NVIDIA Unveils Minerva for AI Factory Observability
items.title_original: NVIDIA Unveils Minerva to Bring End-to-End Observability for AI Factories
items.what_happened: 2026年10月22日，NVIDIA发布Minerva AIOps平台，汇集基础设施与AI工作负载的遥测数据，并用专用AI模型将数据转化为可执行洞察。
items.what_happened_en: On Oct 22, 2026, NVIDIA launched Minerva, an AIOps platform that combines telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads and applies purpose-built AI models to turn data into actionable insight.
items.why_it_matters: 在AI工厂规模下，单个组件性能下降就可能拖慢整个任务；Minerva旨在更早发现问题并保持AI工厂高效运转。
items.why_it_matters_en: At AI-factory scale, a single degraded component can slow an entire job; Minerva aims to find problems earlier and keep AI factories productive.

items.title_cn: NVIDIA DSX瞄准AI数据中心电力瓶颈
items.title_en: NVIDIA DSX Targets AI Data Center Power Bottleneck
items.title_original: How Companies Are Using NVIDIA DSX to Break the Power Bottleneck
items.what_happened: NVIDIA表示，企业正使用其DSX AI工厂平台将电网与AI工厂作为一个系统进行规划、模拟和运行；文中提到逾3000亿美元设备积压，美国并网队列中逾200吉瓦项目待接入。DSX Sim可同时模拟电网、变电站与AI工厂，DSX Flex则将AI工厂需求与电网状况同步。
items.what_happened_en: NVIDIA said companies are using its DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run the grid and the AI factory as one system, citing more than $300 billion in backlogged equipment and over 200 gigawatts of projects waiting in U.S. interconnection queues; DSX Sim simulates grid, substation and AI factory together, and DSX Flex syncs AI factory demand with grid conditions.
items.why_it_matters: 该公司认为，电网、设施与算力设计相互割裂加剧了电力问题，而电力已成为基础设施的最大瓶颈。
items.why_it_matters_en: The company frames power, worsened by siloed grid, facility and compute design, as the biggest bottleneck in infrastructure.

items.title_cn: NVIDIA Earth-2开放模型助力欧洲天气预测
items.title_en: NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models Power European Weather Prediction
items.title_original: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction
items.what_happened: NVIDIA表示，开发者与研究人员可用自有数据定制其Earth-2系列开放AI模型，用于全球天气预测和详细的区域预报；基于欧洲天气与气候数据训练的StormScope EU利用EUMETSAT观测，以10分钟间隔预测16个Meteosat通道的云况，并在GTC柏林与Earthmover合作搭建了实时演示。
items.what_happened_en: NVIDIA said developers and researchers can customize its Earth-2 family of open AI models with their own data for global weather prediction and detailed regional forecasts; StormScope EU, trained on European weather and climate data, uses EUMETSAT observations to predict cloud conditions across 16 Meteosat channels at 10-minute intervals, with a live demo built with Earthmover at GTC Berlin.
items.why_it_matters: 该公司称，及时的天气信息对能源生产商、保险公司和运输运营商根据本地情况做规划至关重要。
items.why_it_matters_en: The company says timely weather information is crucial for energy producers, insurers and transport operators planning around local conditions.
